description: Find the last day to file when a limitation period runs from an accrual date. Send the accrual date and the period you have already looked up, as years, months and/or days (for example 2 years, or 30 days). The accrual day is not counted. If the last day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or a holiday you list, it moves to the next day that is none of those (switch this off if your rule does not move it). Get back the last day to file with its weekday, the day before the move and why it moved, and, if you send today's date, how many days are left. When the last day does not exist in its month (29 Feb + 1 year, 31 Jan + 1 month) the answer says so and shows the other common reading. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/statute-limitations-date). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

accrual_date.description: The date the period starts from (the claim accrued, the injury, the breach, the event), YYYY-MM-DD. The tool does not decide when a claim accrues.

as_of.description: Optional: today's date (or the date you want to measure from), YYYY-MM-DD, to get the days left.

days.description: Days in the period, counted after the years and months (0 if none).

holidays.description: Optional: court holidays that matter here, each YYYY-MM-DD (up to 40). The tool knows no holiday: you send them. Used only when weekend_rollover is on.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'contract claim' (your own text, echoed back; not a party name).

months.description: Months in the period (0 if none).

weekend_rollover.description: true (default): a last day on a Saturday, Sunday or listed holiday moves forward to the next day that is none of those. false: the date is not moved.

years.description: Years in the period (0 if none).

name: statute_limitations_date
title: Limitation Period End Date
